onepager: Time and Entry Billing Agent one-pager.pptx
note: Persona-language locked cases for every implemented month-end billing workflow.

cases.onepager_bullet: Process time entries intelligently to enforce billing rules and accelerate invoice generation
cases.prompt: What billable work is still blocked from this close, and what has to happen before it can move?

cases.onepager_bullet: Generate CFO-ready revenue recognition reports and audit trails
cases.prompt: Give me the month-end billing rollup by project and consultant without treating it as posted revenue.

cases.onepager_bullet: Automate risk and compliance checks to reduce errors and maintain audit-ready documentation
cases.prompt: Which time cards would fail our billing review because of narrative, hours, rate, or budget concerns?

cases.onepager_bullet: Validate time entries and billing rules and generate invoices
cases.prompt: Prepare the invoice support that is actually ready, and keep anything without the right approval or milestone evidence out.

cases.onepager_bullet: Provide dispute resolution intelligence to help protect revenue and preserve client relationships
cases.prompt: What evidence is missing on the disputed hours, and what is the safest resolution path before we go back to the clients?
